Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the screenshot. I can take care of coordinating the proration and a one-off invoice. Looping in Monica (Sales Ops) and our billing lead for final calculation.

Two quick clarifying items that will speed this up:
- Can you confirm the exact start & end timestamps (timezone) for each ephemeral seat instance you observed? Even hour-level accuracy helps us compute daily pro-rata.
- Were any of those seats converted to reserved seats during the window (or were they all burst/ephemeral)? That changes whether we treat them as additional capacity or transient usage.

Our default approach for ephemeral seats is: daily pro-rata against the monthly seat rate for the subscription tier, rounded to the nearest cent, with a credit applied if we subsequently determine overlap with reserved capacity. For US customers we typically don't apply VAT; sales tax depends on billing address and nexus. Monica will prepare a usage export and draft invoice.

I'll wait for the CSV if you have it; otherwise Monica will pull the usage from our logs and share a draft invoice for your approval.

Best,

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the screenshot. I exported the usage we have for your account and attached two files: usage-report-Aug2026.csv and a draft invoice (invoice-ACM-1384-draft.pdf). The CSV contains seat start/end times we observed; let me know if anything from your side differs.

Summary of our proposed calculation (please review):
- Monthly seat rate (Pilot Tier): $450 / seat / month
- Ephemeral seats: 8 seats active Aug 22 09:00 PDT — Aug 26 18:00 PDT
- Billable days per seat: 5 days (we prorate by day for ephemeral seats; partial days count as full day when active > 4 hours)
- Pro-rata formatter: (monthly rate / 30) * days_active * seats = (450 / 30) * 5 * 8 = $6,000.00
- Rounding: nearest cent per-seat, per-day aggregate; total shown on draft invoice

Tax treatment: Based on the billing address on file (California), we did not apply VAT. We have not applied sales tax on this draft because Acme's reseller exemption was on file; if you require sales tax, we can reissue.

Collection & timeline:
- Draft invoice attached (Invoice ACM-1384-DRAFT).
- If approved, we will mark final and send a payable invoice with a payment link and net-7 terms.
- Payment methods: ACH (preferred), card, or wire. ACH details are on the invoice.

Next steps:
1) Confirm the CSV timestamps or attach your CSV if it differs (reply-all).
2) Approve the draft invoice or request adjustments (we can apply a credit if any overlap with reserved seats is found).
3) Once approved, Karthik will finalize and issue the invoice with the payment link.

Regards,
